notes.title: Steam Version Release Date Change: Tuesday, Nov 12, 2024 (JST)
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Metria.

The release was originally scheduled for Thursday, November 7, 2024, but has been postponed due to app review requirements.

- Steam Version Release Date Changed -
We need to change the release date due to significant system changes required for the Steam version update, as developing the app separately for both smartphone and Steam is challenging.

We have decided to postpone it so that new players on Steam can enjoy 'METRIA' alongside our existing players.

The release of METRIA on Steam will be changed to the following date.

Maintenance Schedule: Tuesday, Nov 12, 2024 (JST)

We understand that many of you have been looking forward to it. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.
